maria: Drafting a follow-up docs PR for private bootstrap -> adds explicit proxy examples and a short airgap troubleshooting checklist. Need quick eyes on the KMS transport examples and the HSM mount permissions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2401

sam: On it. Can you paste the minimal curl + python examples you'll include? I'll check for TLS caveats.

maria: Pasted below. curl for token auth through an HTTP proxy (local test):
```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood-local:8443/v1/health \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --proxy http://proxy.corp:3128 \
  --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem \
  -d '{"check":"ok"}'
```
Note: we recommend `--cacert` or a system CA bundle rather than `--insecure` for production.

Python requests example (explicit CA bundle + proxy env):
```py
import os
import requests
os.environ['REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE'] = '/etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem'
proxies = {'http': 'http://proxy.corp:3128', 'https': 'http://proxy.corp:3128'}
resp = requests.post(
    'https://redwood-local:8443/v1/health',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>'},
    proxies=proxies,
    timeout=10
)
print(resp.status_code)
```

jin: Small additions to call out: 1) some proxies terminate TLS and re-proxied HTTPS may need `--proxy-insecure` in local-only debug environments, and 2) highlight REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and `verify` param so folks don't accidentally set verify=False.

maria: Added both notes. Also added a short runtime requirements section: outbound TCP to kms.internal:9000 (TCP/9000), port 443 for control plane, and node must mount `/var/lib/redwood/hsm` with ownership root:redwood and mode 0750.

ops: For the HSM mount note: include example systemd unit volume mount and selinux hint. I added this snippet to the PR under "Runtime -> HSM":
```ini
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-runtime 
# bind mount created by installer
# mount --bind /opt/hsm-plugin /var/lib/redwood/hsm
```
SELinux: chcon -R -t container_file_t /var/lib/redwood/hsm
Permissions: sudo chown root:redwood /var/lib/redwood/hsm && sudo chmod 0750 /var/lib/redwood/hsm
```

sam: Also flag we should surface a short migration checklist for Hosted -> Private: export alert/exported prompts, pin model versions, re-run evals locally with same seed, and double-check any org-level policy webhooks. I can write that bullet list if you want.

maria: Please do, add as a short "Pre-install migration checklist" section.

maria: Added Node example:```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const res = await fetch('https://redwood-local:8443/v1/health', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN },
  agent: new (require('https').Agent)({ ca: require('fs').readFileSync('/etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem') })
});
console.log(await res.status);
```
